APPENDIX 22  Laboratory Values for Nutritional Assessment and Monitoring
Ascorbic acid 
(vitamin C)
Plasma or leukocyte vitamin C 
measured by (1) chromatogra-
phy; (2) by ascorbate oxidase; 
(3) spectrophotometrically by re-
action with 2,4-dinitrophenylhy-
drazine.
Leukocyte C is less affected by  
recent intake, but plasma levels in 
fasting person parallel leukocyte 
levels; plasma preferred for 
acutely ill patients because leuko-
cyte level is affected by infection,22 
some drugs, and hyperglycemia;
